# Abdul Sattar | Sattar Web Studio

> Full-stack software engineer and system architect specializing in React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, .NET, PostgreSQL, and scalable cloud systems.

Sattar Web Studio (https://sattarwebstudio.com) is the engineering consultancy and portfolio of Abdul Sattar. The studio designs, builds, and maintains high-performance web applications, resilient backend architectures, and production-ready digital products for founders, startups, and growing businesses worldwide.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://sattarwebstudio.com/): Engineering services overview, core capabilities, featured projects, and client FAQs.
- [About](https://sattarwebstudio.com/about): Bio, engineering principles, career evolution, and core technical strengths of Abdul Sattar.
- [Services](https://sattarwebstudio.com/services): Custom software development services, architecture design, API development, and cloud deployments.
- [Projects](https://sattarwebstudio.com/projects): Production case studies, architectural blueprints, and engineering implementations.
- [Blog](https://sattarwebstudio.com/blog): Technical articles, architectural guides, and software engineering deep dives.
- [Contact](https://sattarwebstudio.com/contact): Inquiries, project estimates, consultations, and hiring information.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Full-Stack Web Development](https://sattarwebstudio.com/services): Modern, responsive, and accessible user interfaces built with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, backed by robust server-side architecture.
- [Backend Services & APIs](https://sattarwebstudio.com/services): High-throughput REST and GraphQL APIs built with Node.js, NestJS, and .NET, featuring strict type safety, authentication, and validation.
- [System Design & Database Architecture](https://sattarwebstudio.com/services): Scalable relational data modeling with PostgreSQL, high-speed caching with Redis, and distributed microservices architecture.
- [DevOps, Cloud & Deployment](https://sattarwebstudio.com/services): Automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker, cloud infrastructure on AWS and Vercel, and database management with Supabase.
- [Code Auditing & Modernization](https://sattarwebstudio.com/services): Technical debt reduction, performance optimization, and architectural refactoring for existing codebases.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js (App Router, Server Components, SSR), TypeScript, JavaScript (ESNext), Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Backend**: Node.js, NestJS, .NET (C#), Express, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets.
- **Databases & Cache**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase.
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, AWS, Vercel, Linux, Nginx, GitHub Actions, CI/CD.
- **Architecture & Practices**: Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Microservices, REST / RPC design, Test-Driven Development, Performance Optimization.
